sources: Google Maps 'Rudy's Cabins and Campground' (4.6, 34 reviews), read 2026-11-23

hookups.source: https://rudyscabins.wixsite.com/website/about ('All our sites have power, sewer and water with the overnight sites 30 or 50 amp service')

fees.source: https://rudyscabins.wixsite.com/website/about ('$60.00 per night 30amp and $65.00 per night 50 amp'), read 2026-11-23; the page carries a 2022 copyright and no season year

facilities.source: https://rudyscabins.wixsite.com/website/about ('Showers are coin operated and there is also a coin operated laundry mat')

note: Mostly a seasonal RV park, in the operator's words 'mainly a seasonal RV park with a few sites for overnight guests', on fly-fishing-only Clarksville Pond in the Great North Woods; the pond takes kayaks, canoes and rowboats (electric motors only), and RV guests have a dock with seating. ATV trail access. --Claude
summary: Operator page read: full hookups, overnight sites $60 (30A) / $65 (50A), coin showers and laundry, 'mainly a seasonal RV park with a few sites for overnight guests'. DROP CANDIDATE: over the $50 gate with no gateway or Good Sam/member discount, and mostly seasonal. Season, site count and booking were not stated; note rewritten.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (price gate): the cheapest night is $60. The operator says '$60.00 per night 30amp and $65.00 per night 50 amp' (https://rudyscabins.wixsite.com/website/about, read 2026-11-23). All sites have full hookups, so there is no cheaper RV site, and no season pricing is posted. Summer peak is the same $60/$65. gateways.py finds no gateway within 40 km (44.99975,-71.39245). It is not in the Good Sam directory and posts no member discount.

DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay, mostly seasonal): the operator says 'Rudy's is now mainly a seasonal RV park with a few sites for overnight guests' and 'Our Seasonal sites are currently booked, however, we do have a waiting list.' The nightly share is not stated beyond 'a few'. The stored note's '41 sites total: 38 seasonal/long-term, only 3 overnight transient sites' has no source on the operator's pages (about 7% nightly if true). Esri imagery shows the RV area fully packed with parked units in leaf-off season. Google: 4.6 from 34 reviews; review snippets include 'We have been seasons for a few years…', and topic chips 'seasonal (2)' and 'atv trail access (3)'. No wording discourages nightly guests outright, and no minimum stay is posted.

ATV: Google review chips and snippets say 'The campground has access to the ATV trails' (the stored note says ATV-trail access). It is a general campground with an OHV side, not a staging camp. Flag only.

Website: the stored https://rudyscabins.com/ now redirects to https://rudyscabins.wixsite.com/website (Google lists the wixsite URL). Either works; the page carries '©2022' with no dated season or rate year.

Waterfront not waterfront left: Esri imagery shows the pond's south shore along the park's north edge, with a few parked units near the shore by the dock road (around 45.0005,-71.3921). The operator names no lakeside RV sites and says overnight guests share a dock 'for viewing the pond'. The units on the shore look like seasonal sites. The only named waterfront unit is the rental cabin ('situated on the shoreline of the pond with a private dock').

Unread / unverified: season (Memorial Day-November in the stored season, from note prose; the operator pages say nothing), site count 41 and max_rig_ft 50/pull_through (note prose; not on the operator pages). The cabin rate is $225 a night + 9% tax (one cabin, 'building more').
